Remark
[$H^2$ regularity under strict monotonicity] ↗ thm:monotonicity-uniqueness-weak-solution ↗ thm:interior-h2-regularity 1. ch9:9.1-rem-2\group Elliptic Regularity

Under (20), the weak solution belongs to $H^2(U)$ and satisfies \[ -\Div \, \mathbf{a}(Du) = f \quad \text{a.e. in } U. \] Indeed, applying (20) to $p=q+h\xi $ and sending $h\to 0$ gives \[ \sum _{i,j=1}^{n} a^i_{p_j}(q)\xi _i\xi _j \geq \theta |\xi |^2 \quad (q, \xi \in \R ^n). \tag {21} \] Thus the linearized coefficient matrix is uniformly elliptic, and the difference-quotient regularity argument applies (cf. subsection thm:interior-h2-regularity).
